cap: Abnormal uterine bleeding is sorted by PALM-COEIN: polyp, adenomyosis, leiomyoma and malignancy are structural; coagulopathy, ovulatory dysfunction, endometrial, iatrogenic and not otherwise classified are not. Ovulatory dysfunction causes irregular, unpredictable bleeding, and its branch shows polycystic ovary syndrome by the Rotterdam criteria, DHEA-S to separate adrenal from ovarian androgen tumors, and the female athlete triad.
